Name: Better Beehouses
Author: tlitookilakin
TagLine: All around improvements to beehouses! Use them indoors, in winter, with potted flowers, and more!
Description:
![About](http://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/about.png)
Better Beehouses aims to make bee houses more versatile, more usable, and all around better. Current features include:
* They can produce honey indoors
* They can produce honey during winter
* They can use flowers planted in pots
* Change the rate at which they produce honey
* Change the range to search for flowers
* Allow using forage flowers
* Change the value of honey with a multiplier
* Allow honey to have quality
* Fancy bee particles with Particle Effects mod   
* Allow using giant crops
* Allow using trees
* Option to select a random flower instead of the nearest one
* Increase output amount based on the number of nearby flowers

Supports the following languages:
* Ukrainian ([ChulkyBow](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/80961158)﻿)
* Portuguese ([c4ttzinhaa](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/148478623)﻿)
* Chinese ([TangKeke](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/132842668)﻿)

![Configuration](http://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/configuration.png)
Better Beehouses can be configured using the config.json file in the mod folder, or in game with [GMCM](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098)﻿! GMCM updates INSTANTLY, (as soon as you hit save,) so feel free to take a look at the options and customize to your heart's desire!

![Compatibility](http://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/compatibility.png)
#### Fully Compatible
* Automate: Beehouses can be automated, and better beehouses settings will apply.
* Walk of Life: Beehouses will benefit from the producer perk. Beehouses will produce 2x as often as configured, and 4x when prestiged, with a minimum of 1 day.
* Quality of Life: The quality settings on Quality of Life will override the quality from this mod if enabled.
* Range Highlight: Fully integrated. Shows adjusted range of bee houses.
#### Partially Compatible
* Producer Framework Mod: To prevent tampering, Better Beehouses prevents the bee house from being registered as a producer. Most of the time, this should be a non-issue, since bee houses only produce honey anyways.
* Data Layers: Data Layers will not show the adjusted range, or show range indoors. Integration is in progress, and will release as an update to Data Layers when complete.
#### Incompatible
Better Beehouses currently has no known incompatibilities.

![Installation](http://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/installation.png)
1. Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)﻿.
2. Unzip this mod into the Mods folder.
